command:
set -u
base=/srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization
out=$base/normalized
tab=$(printf '\t')
status=0
while IFS="$tab" read -r name enc extra; do
  [ "$name" = file ] && continue
  if [ -z "$name" ] || [ -z "$enc" ] || [ -n "${extra:-}" ]; then
    printf 'ERROR malformed manifest row for %s\n' "${name:-<empty>}"
    status=1
    continue
  fi
  case "$name" in */*|.|..) printf 'ERROR unsafe filename: %s\n' "$name"; status=1; continue ;; esac
  src=$base/incoming/$name
  target=$out/$name
  decoded=$(mktemp "$out/.decoded.XXXXXX") || exit 1
  staged=$(mktemp "$out/.normalized.XXXXXX") || { rm -f "$decoded"; exit 1; }
  err=$(mktemp "$out/.iconv-error.XXXXXX") || { rm -f "$decoded" "$staged"; exit 1; }
  if iconv -f "$enc" -t UTF-8 "$src" >"$decoded" 2>"$err"; then
    if sed 's/\r$//' "$decoded" >"$staged" && iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 "$staged" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      chmod 0644 "$staged"
      chown root:root "$staged"
      mv -f "$staged" "$target"
      restorecon "$target" 2>/dev/null || :
      printf 'PUBLISHED %s (%s -> UTF-8, LF)\n' "$name" "$enc"
    else
      printf 'ERROR normalization failed for %s; no output published\n' "$name"
      status=1
    fi
  else
    msg=$(tr '\n' ' ' <"$err" | sed 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
    printf 'UNDECODABLE %s as %s: %s; no output published\n' "$name" "$enc" "$msg"
    status=1
  fi
  rm -f "$decoded" "$staged" "$err"
done < "$base/encodings.tsv"
printf 'conversion_status=%s\n' "$status"
exit 0

command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization
out=$base/normalized
printf '%s\n' '== published files =='
find "$out" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf '%f %M %u:%g %s bytes\n' | sort
printf '%s\n' '== strict UTF-8 validation =='
for f in "$out"/*; do iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 "$f" >/dev/null; printf '%s: valid UTF-8\n' "${f##*/}"; done
printf '%s\n' '== exact normalized bytes =='
for f in "$out"/*; do printf '%s\n' "-- ${f##*/}"; od -An -tx1 -v "$f"; done
printf '%s\n' '== decoded records (visible line ends) =='
for f in "$out"/*; do printf '%s\n' "-- ${f##*/}"; sed -n 'l' "$f"; done
printf '%s\n' '== CR rejection, LF counts, terminal state =='
for f in "$out"/*; do
  if LC_ALL=C grep -q "$(printf '\r')" "$f"; then cr=present; else cr=absent; fi
  lf=$(od -An -v -tu1 "$f" | tr -s ' ' '\n' | awk '$1==10{n++} END{print n+0}')
  last=$(tail -c 1 "$f" | od -An -tu1 | tr -d ' ')
  printf '%s cr=%s lf=%s final_newline=%s\n' "${f##*/}" "$cr" "$lf" "$([ "${last:-}" = 10 ] && printf yes || printf no)"
done
[ ! -e "$out/invalid.txt" ]
printf '%s\n' 'invalid.txt: absent as required after decode failure'

  printf '%s\n' 'invalid.txt: unexpectedly decodable'; rm -f /tmp/normalization-check.err; exit 1
else

  tr '\n' ' ' </tmp/normalization-check.err | sed 's/[[:space:]]*$//'

fi
[ ! -e "$base/normalized/invalid.txt" ]
printf '%s\n' 'invalid.txt: no published output'
